testflight_summary:
- Texture upscaling now starts with the main menu art, including the big HALO logo. On the import screen, "Start playing" appears once the menu textures are ready, and a single progress bar covers the whole set. iOS and tvOS show progress only until then.
- The loading screen now shows an "Upscaling textures" spinner with "Press A to Skip" while a level's textures are made. The loading bar moves through the whole wait, and a missing loading picture no longer shows black.
- Network games hold the loading screen until the map is ready. You should no longer see the sky alone, a missing weapon or HUD, or a camera outside the level when joining a game in progress.
- Pause menus no longer move your player. In split-screen, one player's pause menu no longer freezes the others. On touch, only menu controls reach the game while a menu is open.
- Player names over heads are off by default. Only the name of the player under your reticle shows. You can still choose all, allies, or enemies in settings.
- The Server Browser now joins version 39 hosts and marks dedicated games. The game count no longer shows "(0 dedicated)", and BIG is shown only for games at least half as full as your device can hold.
- External displays now fill the screen and recover when plugged in while the game is running. Dynamic resolution is on for iPhone 15 Pro and iPhone 16e.
- Old installs with `debug.texture_upscale_generate = false` now use auto, so upscaling works again after an upgrade.

iCloud Saves is new and starts off. To try it, sign in to iCloud on each device, then turn on iCloud Saves under Network Setup in the game's profile settings (on iPhone, iPad and Apple Vision Pro also on VISR's page in the Settings app). It takes effect at the next launch.

VISR automatically sends missing shader descriptions and device model information to improve loading. Reports exclude gameplay and personal file names. Apple's upload service attaches an account-specific identifier. Shader diagnostics are required in builds with shader uploads enabled.

VISR automatically sends game performance data to improve the game. Reports exclude names, chat, and personal file names. Apple's upload service attaches an account-specific identifier. Performance diagnostics are required in builds with performance reports enabled. Sharing this data is part of testing; leaving the beta stops it.
